_: Grades the shared run-step parser through run-ci-lint.test.mjs. Not a guard: ci-run-steps.mjs is imported, never wired.

expectRed: a compact `- run:` list-item step executes
live ci.yml lint job parses to include the decisions-ledger guard with base origin/master
a trailing YAML comment on a frozen pnpm install is stripped from the listed command
mutations.note: Drops the optional `- ` list-item prefix from the run-line regex; a compact `- run:` step is no longer parsed.

expectRed: a run scalar continued on a deeper line aborts
mutations.note: A plain or quoted `run:` continued on a deeper line no longer aborts; only its first line runs.

expectRed: live ci.yml lint job parses to include the decisions-ledger guard with base origin/master
a step with neither run: nor uses: parsed aborts naming its number; a uses: step does not
mutations.note: The `uses` flag is never set; a `uses:` step reads as a step with no run: or uses: and aborts.

expectRed: job-level container, services and strategy abort before any step runs
mutations.note: Job-level container, services and strategy are no longer flagged unsupported.
